_note: Machine-readable definition of every prediction task: what is predicted, in which unit, where the value comes from, which inputs are allowed, and what counts as one independent experiment. src/run_cv_evaluation.py only evaluates a task when its dataset is VERIFIED_SOURCE in reports/data_provenance_audit.json AND every unit/label below is marked verified. Physically different quantities are never merged into one target. Text convention: plain key = English, *_zh = Chinese.

tasks.title: Peak heat-release rate of PMMA in the cone calorimeter (ground tests)
tasks.title_zh: 锥形量热仪中 PMMA 的峰值热释放率（地面试验）
tasks.group_definition: Testing laboratory. Runs from one lab share apparatus, specimen batch and procedure, so a whole lab is always kept in one partition. This is stricter than treating each run as independent.
tasks.group_definition_zh: 测试实验室。同一实验室的试验共享设备、试样批次与流程，因此整个实验室始终位于同一分区，比把每次试验视为独立更严格。

target.unit_evidence: Unit row of every source CSV is checked to be kW/m2 by src/build_measured_cone_dataset.py (_summarize_file).
target.definition: Maximum recorded HRR over the complete measured experiment.
target.unit_evidence_zh: src/build_measured_cone_dataset.py（_summarize_file）会检查每个来源 CSV 的单位行是否为 kW/m2。

features.origin: test condition parsed from the source file name
derived from the same measured HRR curve: time between first and last HRR >= 10 kW/m2
derived from the same measured HRR curve: time-weighted mean while burning

tasks.prediction_stage_note: Two inputs summarise the same curve the target comes from, so this task estimates a missing peak from a burn summary. It is not a pre-test forecast and says nothing about microgravity.
tasks.prediction_stage_note_zh: 其中两个输入来自同一条测量曲线，因此该任务是根据燃烧汇总估算缺失的峰值，而不是试验前的预测，也与微重力无关。

derived_classification.name: high_hazard_350
derived_classification.rule: predicted peak >= 350 kW/m2 (project threshold, not a trained classifier)

tasks.title: FLEX droplet burning-rate constant (microgravity, ISS)
tasks.title_zh: FLEX 液滴燃烧速率常数（微重力，国际空间站）
tasks.group_definition: Test date. Tests on the same day share a chamber fill and hardware setup, so a whole day is kept in one partition instead of treating each droplet as independent.
tasks.group_definition_zh: 试验日期。同一天的试验共用一次舱内充气与硬件设置，因此整天的试验放在同一分区，而不是把每个液滴视为独立。

target.unit_evidence: NASA/TP-2015-216046 Appendix A.1: 'average burning rate constant from a linear fit of the droplet diameter squared versus time'; Table IX header 'Burning rate, mm2/s'. The PSI CSV header 'Burning rate; mm' is truncated.
target.unit_evidence_zh: NASA/TP-2015-216046 附录 A.1：“由液滴直径平方对时间的线性拟合得到的平均燃烧速率常数”；表 IX 表头为“Burning rate, mm2/s”。PSI CSV 表头“Burning rate; mm”是被截断的写法。

features.origin: test condition (PSI header 'CO' = CO2 per NASA/TP-2015-216046 Table IX)

tasks.excluded_features_note: x_n2 is omitted because it equals 1 minus the other mole fractions. Extinction diameter, burn time and test end are outcomes of the same burn and are not available before the test.

tasks.title: FLEX: does the flame go out before the droplet is used up?
tasks.title_zh: FLEX：火焰是否在液滴耗尽前熄灭？
tasks.group_definition: Test date (same reason as the burning-rate task).
tasks.group_definition_zh: 试验日期（理由同燃烧速率任务）。

mapping.Extinction: 1: the visible flame went out while fuel remained
mapping.Disruption: excluded: the droplet broke apart, so the burn ended for another reason

label.mapping_evidence: NASA/TP-2015-216046 Appendix A.1: a '-' extinction diameter 'indicates flame extinction did not occur either because the droplet burned to completion or because a droplet disruption ended the test'. Table IX Test end values: Completion, Disruption, Extinction.
label.mapping_note: Disruption is not pooled with Completion. This task predicts the reported test outcome; it does not define or validate a quenching boundary.

mapping_zh.Extinction: 1：可见火焰在燃料尚存时熄灭
mapping_zh.Disruption: 排除：液滴破碎，燃烧因其他原因结束

label.mapping_note_zh: 破碎不与燃尽合并。该任务预测的是报告中的试验结果，并不定义或验证熄火边界。

tasks.title: BASS-II solid-fuel flame-spread speed
tasks.title_zh: BASS-II 固体燃料火焰蔓延速度

target.note: The verified PSI-25 experimental table has no flame-spread column. Measured spread rates appear only in report tables such as NASA/TM-20210011385 Table 5.1 (PMMA slabs); they would have to be transcribed and verified first.

tasks.history: The retired pipeline invented this target as fan_setting x 0.0016 x 1.5, which also fed an input feature (label leakage).

tasks.title: BASS-II extinction

label.note: The verified PSI-25 experimental table records no extinction outcome.

tasks.history: The retired pipeline labelled a burn 'extinguished' when final CO <= 2 ppm, a rule rather than an observed outcome.
